lifecycle_note: Now part of Arcade.dev. On 2026-10-31 Smithery shut down its API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and API keys, server URLs on run.tools and server.smithery.ai, and deprecated its CLI and SDKs; smithery.ai continues only as a public, non-proxied MCP registry powered by Arcade.dev.

updates.old: Catalog and connection layer for MCP servers
updates.new: Public directory of MCP servers, now part of Arcade.dev. Until 2026-10-31 it was also a connection layer (hosted MCP proxy, Connect, Toolbox, managed credentials, API, CLI and SDKs); those shut down that day, and verified servers' registry pages now list direct MCP URLs.

updates.old: 📣 Smithery's MCP Proxy and managed identity shut down on October 31.
updates.new: Smithery remains a public (non-proxied) MCP registry powered by Arcade.dev; server URLs on run.tools and server.smithery.ai, the Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and API keys stop working on 2026-10-31, and the CLI and SDKs are deprecated.
